name: Add a key to your keyring
description: Move an Ed25519 seed or a BIP39 phrase from one of your secrets into your keyring, where it can be used under your authority but never read. The secret stays where it is; delete it if the keyring copy is the only one you want.

operation.activityLabel: Add a key to your keyring

seed.description: Reference to your own secret holding a 32-byte hexadecimal Ed25519 seed: s/NAME. Give this or mnemonic. Never pass the seed inline.

mnemonic.description: Reference to your own secret holding an English BIP39 phrase: s/NAME. Give this or seed. Never pass the phrase inline.

label.description: Your own name for the key or phrase in the keyring.

overwrite.description: For a key or phrase already held, replace its label. Otherwise adding it again fails.

accountKey.description: For a key: its native 32-byte Ed25519 AccountKey; JSON renders it as a 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string.

did.description: The key's did:key, or a phrase's ID: the did:key of its SLIP-10 master node with no passphrase.

words.description: For a phrase: its number of words.
